sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10235835, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10235835 ('Guyandotte ... offers electric to full hookup sites'; amenities 'Electric Hookups', 'Water Hookups', 'Sewer Hookup') + /rates (2026 Peak: 'PeakFullHookupcampsites': 32, 'PeakStandardelectriccampsites': 26) + RIDB catalog (all 86 public sites list Electricity Hookup 50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The catalog lists 84 standard electric sites and 2 group electric sites (plus 6 management sites), all back-in, in two loops, Reedy Creek and Locust Branch; 21 of them are long-term sites. No vehicle lengths in the catalog.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 10235835 (84 STANDARD ELECTRIC, 2 GROUP STANDARD ELECTRIC, 6 MANAGEMENT; Driveway Entry Back-in on all public sites) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10235835 ('Cam[ground has two loops'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showerhouses, restrooms and playgrounds; shoreline fishing.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10235835 ('The campgroiund offers developed showerhouses and playgrounds'; 'restroom, showers'; amenities 'Drinking Water', 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 nights in any 30 days, except the long-term sites (Reedy Creek 3, 5, 7, 12, 13, 15, 23-27; Locust Branch 50, 52, 53, 61, 73, 75, 80, 81, 93, 94), which need 16 to 90 consecutive nights. Check-in 6 p.m., check-out 5 p.m. A Federal pass discount needs the pass holder registered on and occupying the site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10235835 (notices: 'No person(s) may camp at one or more campsites for more than 14 days in a 30 day consecutive period except on the sited designated as Long Term Campsites'; 'These sites have a minimum stay of 16 consecutive nights and a maximum stay of 90 consecutive nights. All other sites will have a 14 night maximum consecutive stay.'; 'Check out time is 5 p.m. Check in time is 6 p.m.') + RIDB catalog (87 of 92 sites reservable), read 2026-10-21

note: USACE (Huntington District) campground on the upper branch of R.D. Bailey Lake, in two loops (Reedy Creek and Locust Branch) with playgrounds and shoreline fishing. Open May-Oct. --Claude
summary: rec.gov description/notices/rates + RIDB catalog: confirmed 50-amp electric to full hookups, $26 standard electric / $32 full hookup 2026 peak (fees unchanged), showers, dump, reservable on rec.gov. Changed site count 94 (note prose) -> 86 public catalog sites, all back-in. Added drinking water, 14-night limit with 21 long-term (16-90 night) sites. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only), booking window, max rig length. Note trimmed of what the fields carry.
flags: 21 of the 86 sites are long-term sites with a 16-night minimum and 90-night maximum ('Guyandotte Campground will be offering Long Term Camping opportunities'); the other 65 keep a 14-night maximum and ordinary nightly booking, so nights are still for sale to a passing traveller.
Season unconfirmed: rec.gov gives only rate seasons (2026 Peak May 16 - Sep 7); the note's 'Open May-Oct' and season.year_round false rest on note prose.
